name: UK CPI (index), as the IMF publishes it
description: The national all-items consumer price index as the International Monetary Fund publishes it (dataflow IMF.STA:CPI). The Fund labels its reference period 2015A. It is not the Office for National Statistics' CPI (D7BT), which v1 showed and which stays the Series `uk_cpi`: over 2000 to 2026 the two drift apart by up to two percent, and their twelve-month changes by more than a point (compared on 2026-11-11). Which national index the Fund carries here is not established.
